primary.title: 48-hour EOMES ChIP targets and cell-fate programs after EOMES perturbation.
primary.text: (A) Enrichment of upregulated and downregulated DE genes among the fixed top 500 (left) and top 1,500 (right) 48-hour ChIP targets. Values are observed/expected overlaps; * one-sided Fisher BH q < 0.05 across 20 tests. (B, C) Unweighted GSEA of cell-type signatures using all expression-eligible genes (B) or excluding the 48-hour top 1,500 targets (C). Values are normalized enrichment scores (NES); red indicates higher and blue lower expression after perturbation. * BH q < 0.05 across all tested signatures and five contrasts, separately per panel. References: Tyser et al. (2021), human gastrula; Cao et al. (2020), human fetal atlas. DE2 denotes anterior-enriched definitive endoderm. Whole-gene and knock-in KO share WT samples; both degron comparisons share perturbed samples, with matched uninduced or auxin-treated parental controls. Reference similarity does not assign a cell fate; genes outside the target list are not proven indirect targets.

sensitivity.title: ReMap sensitivity analysis.
sensitivity.text: The primary workflow applied once to the fixed 1,446-gene ReMap EOMES reference set. Panel A uses directional Fisher tests, with BH correction across 10 comparisons; panel C excludes ReMap targets. Panel B is identical to the primary all-gene cell-fate analysis. This figure is supplementary and does not replace the 48-hour ChIP result. Other definitions and caveats follow Figure 1.
